limits: Host IOKit/cache doubles with the actual NativeAdrenoMemory implementation; fake physical addresses are not K80 evidence.

At most8provider allocation calls, no retry or cleanup by the owner; IOKit allocation/cache helpers can block and existing maintenance statistics use a CAS retry. This is not a wall-time guarantee; future runtime needs normal thread and independent watchdog.
Callback and allocation width are caller gate/policy, not real SMP or SMMU/OAS qualification.
Existing failed allocator may internally release its own unpublished allocation. A retained quarantine exposes original failure plus quarantine, not the unexposed secondary cleanup code.
No CPU/GMU IOVA assignment, firmware copy/load, cache policy change, holdForDevice, service attachment, MMIO/power/PAS/SCM/SMMU/phone operation.
Native relocatable closure is not a final kernel B/BL/ABI/source/start.o/payload/ready qualification.
